patch.head: immutable R3 REVIEWED.patch applied to frozen subject (no head commit supplied)

impact.rationale: Persistent workload choices and shared model execution semantics are affected, together with the existing scheduled provider-health contract and native/voice confirmation surfaces.

regressionLikelihood.rationale: All established R1/R2 control/contract gaps are corrected or explicitly contained by blocking harness switching. The patch still spans persistent preferences, native UI, scheduled status and HTTP/MCP surfaces, with partial integration protection and no live rollout check.

regressionProtection.rationale: Frozen final backend log reports 238 passes. R2 native log reports 16 passes and native implementation/test files are byte-identical in R3. New fail-on-call tests cover all disabled spellings and parser gaps. Independent focused AST probe verified actual kill-switch enforcement. Full suites were not independently rerun; no full native/live deployment verification.

recoverability.rationale: Code can be reverted without a schema migration. Saved preference rows remain, and any subsequent model use cannot be undone; operators must inspect saved state before restoring old behavior. Old clients cannot use v1 previews safely.

confidence.rationale: R3 patch SHA and all 25 changed-file after-hashes verified. Full R2-to-R3 comparison found only the five expected correction files. Actual extracted handlers, _status_call and status_enabled rejected all four disabled values without dependency calls and preserved enabled calls. Earlier reviewed paths unchanged.

applicability.rationale: Existing launchd job, native Model Access, AdminAPI and MCP status calls reach the new code. No deployment or service execution was performed.

statusQuoRisk.rationale: Base still permits mutable preference labels and instruction-only voice confirmation; R2 removes voice confirmation and blocks harness changes, materially reducing that risk. New public-document discovery is optional and bounded; complete harness switching remains unavailable.

materialBoundaries.invariant: When JARVIS_STATUS_TOOLS_ENABLED is falsy, all /api/status/* routes must refuse before status work or external effects.
materialBoundaries.counterexample: Call both routes under false, 0, no and off; refreshed public HTTP/cache work must not occur.
materialBoundaries.legitimateControl: R3 wraps each thunk with _status_call. New tests install fail-on-call fakes. Independent execution of actual AST-extracted handlers, _status_call and status_enabled produced disabled responses with zero reader/refresher calls for all four values; enabled paths reached the proper fakes.

materialBoundaries.invariant: An LLM boolean/token alone must not authorize a selection change.
materialBoundaries.counterexample: Call confirm=true with a valid old/new draft token.
materialBoundaries.legitimateControl: Revised branch always returns refusal; confirm_preference is no longer imported. Preview includes exact models but no returned approval token. Regression tests verify no saved preference.

materialBoundaries.invariant: Routed metadata must not be represented as the configured or active legacy voice baseline.
materialBoundaries.counterexample: Legacy OPENAI_MODEL differs from routed selection.
materialBoundaries.legitimateControl: configured_selection is explicitly routed_selection_only and applies_to_voice_runtime false; report baseline and active_model are null and switching false; native summary states unknown runtime.

materialBoundaries.invariant: Do not claim or expose a complete harness switch without durable identity/adoption enforcement.
materialBoundaries.counterexample: Old voice draft or ordinary stage/confirm attempts to save a controller choice; later registry edit changes a nonvoice profile alias.
materialBoundaries.legitimateControl: Backend rejects both new and existing voice drafts. Nonvoice remains a mutable selection snapshot with an explicit future-registry-edit disclaimer; complete pinning/ACK is documented future work, not a delivered guarantee.

materialBoundaries.invariant: The new passive addition preserves prior scheduled health behavior without adding provider calls.
materialBoundaries.counterexample: Legacy job succeeds/fails while a harness notice needs refresh.
materialBoundaries.legitimateControl: Original vault/migration/run path restored; independent guarded run_passive follows. Tests assert legacy then passive in both success/failure. run_passive only reuses cached sources/local selection and notice API.

materialBoundaries.invariant: Stale evidence and routed-selection changes must not become current voice availability/upgrade claims.
materialBoundaries.counterexample: Old retrieval timestamps, changed selection digest, missing or malformed cache.
materialBoundaries.legitimateControl: Sources are revalidated, original retrieval dates retained, source age/current digest checked. Native displays freshness; stale/mismatched summary is historical and baseline remains null. No model switching authority is derived.

materialBoundaries.invariant: Discovery does not send local data/credentials or trigger inference/model changes.
materialBoundaries.counterexample: Redirect, API URL, document instruction, implicit scheduled refresh.
materialBoundaries.legitimateControl: Fixed URL allowlist, no redirects or credential headers, response bound, regex-only extraction; passive path does not call collect/fetch. Explicit refresh is separate POST/native action.
